description:
Get one Form D filing in full, by accession number (from search_private_offerings).

Everything search returns, plus: the issuer's full address, phone and previous names;
co-issuers; related persons (executive officers, directors, promoters) with their roles and
addresses as filed; sales compensation recipients (placement agents and brokers) with FINRA CRD
numbers, their broker-dealer and the states they solicited in; notes the filer added to amounts,
fees and use of proceeds; the signatures; and offering_history: every filing of the same offering
(original notice and amendments, oldest first) with its cumulative amount sold and investor count,
which shows how the raise filled over time.

Args:
    accession_number: Form D accession number, e.g. "0001104659-26-114962"
name: get_private_offering
title: Get Private Offering (Form D)
